definitions.grahana_dosha: Natal Moon conjoined with Rahu or Ketu (or Sun with Rahu/Ketu) - counts as grahana dosha whether or not an actual eclipse occurred at birth.
definitions.core_principle: The same combination can be positive, negative or neutral. Decide using: sign, dispositor strength, nakshatra sharing, and Jupiter / 1-5-9 lord influence.
neutralisers: lagna lord, lord_5 or lord_9 conjoins or aspects the combination (lords of 5 and 9 help even if natural malefics)
definitions.same_nakshatra_rule: If the two planets of a node combination sit in the SAME nakshatra, the combination turns negative even when otherwise strong.

rules.name: Sun-Moon conjunction (Amavasya / Siva-Sakti yoga)
rules.result: A yoga, not a flaw - intelligent and capable; myth that new-moon births become thieves is rejected. Benefits the sign occupied and the 7th sign from it.

house_variants.6: Enemies do not survive against the native
house_variants.12: Fame through a unique personal skill

rules.name: Moon-Rahu in Moon's own or exaltation sign
rules.condition: Moon + Rahu (or Ketu) in Kadagam or Rishabam
rules.result: Big yoga - Rahu amplifies Moon's results (roughly 3x). Moon dasa (10y) + Rahu dasa (18y) can give ~28 years of good period.
conditions: In Rishabam: dispositor Venus must be strong (not debilitated, retrograde, or in 6/8/12 from lagna or from Moon)
failure: Venus weak -> loss of wealth/business, friction with mother, legal and property disputes, maternal-property issues
Moon and Rahu in the same nakshatra -> negative despite strength
rules.example: Thulam lagna: Moon-Rahu in 10th (Kadagam) = career success multiplied; in 8th (Rishabam, Moon exalted) = even larger success if Venus strong.

rules.name: Moon-Rahu/Ketu in other signs
rules.condition: Moon + Rahu or Ketu outside Kadagam/Rishabam

branches.then: Yoga. Example: Magaram lagna, Moon-Rahu in 2nd (Kumbam) with Saturn exalted -> timely marriage, family settles abroad with good income and foreign property (instead of the textbook left-eye / mother problems).
Negative - marriage/family turmoil even with strong dispositor.
Severe hardship through the combined Moon + Rahu dasas: family, finances, status, health suffer; relocation.

branches.if: dispositor debilitated BUT Jupiter aspects both the conjunction and the debilitated dispositor
branches.then: Turns into a large yoga - a debilitated planet aspected by Jupiter gives better-than-exalted results; Moon-Jupiter mutual aspect also forms Gajakesari.

rules.name: Moon-Ketu with dispositor test
rules.example_condition: Moon + Ketu in 2nd (Viruchigam) for Thulam lagna

branches.if: Mars retrograde or debilitated (e.g. 8th from the pair)
Mars debilitated, no Jupiter aspect, BUT lagna lord / lord_5 / lord_9 conjoins or aspects the pair
branches.then: Neutralised - not a big yoga, but no ruin

rules.condition: Group of planets in one sign
rules.result: Positive if the sign's lord is strong; negative otherwise.

rules.condition: Jupiter and Moon in the same nakshatra
rules.result: Rarely positive - only if their dispositor is strong or Jupiter is own/exalted; otherwise neutral.

rules.condition: Node in a sign whose lord and nakshatra lord are in 6/8 relation (e.g. Ketu in Poorattathi in Kumbam with Saturn-Jupiter 6/8)
rules.result: Node acts negatively; if sign lord and star lord are conjoined, positively. House number irrelevant.

branches.if: Rahu and Saturn connected (conjunction, aspect, star exchange) in general
conjoined in Magaram, Kumbam or Thulam
conjoined there AND in the same nakshatra
different nakshatras AND Jupiter or 1/5/9 lord influence

dasa_pair_rules.condition: Venus and Rahu connected by conjunction, aspect or star exchange

strength_rules.condition: Moon debilitated (e.g. 11th lord for Kanni lagna in 3rd) BUT Moon's dispositor in mutual 7th (samasaptama) aspect with Venus
strength_rules.result: Moon dasa still brings success and expansion. Attributed to Kerala astrology texts.

strength_rules.condition: Lagna and lagna lord afflicted BUT Moon unafflicted and Moon's dispositor strong
Retrograde Saturn in mutual 7th aspect with Sun
strength_rules.result: Good position in employment (not own business); superiors lift them if Sun is strong, pressure from superiors if Sun is weak.
Contrarian nature - tends to take the opposite stand.

strength_rules.definition: Planet in the same sign in D1 and D9 = vargottama = strong. Exalted in D1 but debilitated in D9 = weak.
strength_rules.alternative: Planet strength can also be judged by the nakshatra lord's condition instead of D9.

strength_rules.result: Moon in 4th (karako bhava nashti) should not be read literally; mother can live long.

transit_eclipse_rules.condition: Eclipse occurs in sign S, nakshatra N
transit_eclipse_rules.result: Traditionally S, adjacent signs, adjacent nakshatras and N's trine stars (janma/anujanma) are flagged for remedies.

transit_eclipse_rules.condition: Eclipse falls in 6th from natal Moon
transit_eclipse_rules.result: Good time to act on job moves, foreign travel, arts, disputes, court cases, health and property issues - long-pending matters can resolve.

transit_eclipse_rules.condition: Eclipse falls in 11th from natal Moon
Eclipse sign is 7th from Simha (i.e. in Kumbam)
transit_eclipse_rules.result: Pressure on those in authority; earning members may feel their word carries less weight at home.

eclipse_time_guidance: Favourable for japa, mantra initiation, meditation, charity and focused study (including children's school study)
Drinking water during eclipse is fine
Claims that black magic works better during eclipses are rejected
Children born during an eclipse are not ill-fated; tend to be mentally strong

prashna_rules.principle: The query topic can be read from the Moon's combination at query time (e.g. nakshatra lord + weekday lord). Example: Jupiter star on a Sunday -> Jupiter+Sun themes: govt/bank jobs, children, eldest child's education, promotion.

misc.result: 3rd house is the 8th from the 8th (bhavat bhavam) - key to judging the 8th.
Strong Mars -> strong devotion to Murugan.
